title: Transparent Grass
description: Makes grass transparent to increase visibility.
body: # Description Makes grass transparent, allowing you to see players and mobs on the other side more easily. Currently doesn't support other blocks besides short and tall grass. Since it's making solid blocks transparent, it may not be allowed on some servers, so make sure to check with staff. # Versions Supports Java Edition 26.2 (older versions untested) # Compatibility Incompatible with anything modifying the grass texture.
